title: SceneSpec
description: Everything one Tier 1 frame depends on (PRD section 9.2), renderer 0.2.0. Heights are metres above mean sea level unless a name says _agl; angles are degrees; azimuths are clockwise from true north. Mirrors validateScene() in renderer/src/scene.ts (a test checks they agree). Rules this schema cannot express, which validateScene() also enforces: seed == deriveSeed(viewpoint_id, run_init_utc); timestamps must be real instants (no 30 February; the patterns already exclude month 13, day 32, hour 24, second 60); valid_time_utc lies 0 to 384 h after run_init_utc; cover_profile distances and wind_series lead_h values strictly increase; wind_series read at the valid time is within 0.05 m/s of wind_u_ms / wind_v_ms; sun is within 1 degree of the solar position for valid_time_utc at the camera.

valid_time_utc.description: Valid time, ISO 8601 in UTC with a Z suffix. Must be a real instant (checked by validateScene).

run_init_utc.description: Initialisation time of the forecast run, canonical YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (the string deriveSeed hashes). PRD 9.5: the clouds of a run are fixed here and advect by the time integral of the wind up to valid_time_utc, which lies 0-384 h later (checked by validateScene).

renderer_version.description: Renderer version the scene was issued for; render() is pure in (scene, renderer version).

seed.description: PRD 9.5: deriveSeed(viewpoint_id, run_init_utc), 16 hex chars of SHA-256 of 'lookout-seed-v1|<viewpoint_id>|<run_init_utc>' (checked by validateScene). The same (viewpoint, run, valid time) always gives the same pixels.

heading_deg.description: Azimuth of the optical axis, clockwise from true north.

pitch_deg.description: Elevation of the optical axis, up positive.

roll_deg.description: Rotation about the optical axis, positive = camera turned clockwise as seen from behind.

hfov_deg.description: Full horizontal field of view; square pixels.

agl_m.description: Optional camera height above the ground under it (default 10 m); sets the v0 flat-ground height.

sun.description: Supplied by the caller for now (TODO(M2): computed inside via oculus-core WASM). validateScene rejects a Sun more than 1 degree from the NOAA solar position for valid_time_utc at the camera.

moon.description: Supplied by the caller; not checked yet (TODO(M2): computed inside via oculus-core WASM).

layers.description: At most one layer of each name.

cover_profile.description: Forecast cover against great-circle distance from the camera along the view; linear between knots, constant beyond the ends. Distances strictly increasing (checked by validateScene).

ceiling_m_msl.description: Base of the lowest broken/overcast layer. v0: a solid 300 m slab unless the height lies inside a declared layer.

visibility_m.description: Near-surface visibility diagnostic (HRRR VIS). Applied only below 100 m above ground (PRD 9.3), as the excess over clear-air haze.

precip_rate_mm_h.description: Accepted and hashed; not rendered in v0 (TODO(M2) pass 7).

wind_u_ms.description: Eastward wind at the valid time. Without wind_series, the clouds advect as if it had blown constantly since run_init_utc.

wind_v_ms.description: Northward wind at the valid time (see wind_u_ms).

visibility_epsilon.description: Optional Koschmieder contrast threshold (default 0.02, so beta = 3.912 / V).

wind_series.description: Optional wind against lead time since run_init_utc, for example HRRR's hourly winds: linear between knots, constant beyond. The cloud drift is its exact time integral from 0 to the valid time, so scrubbing across forecast hours is continuous. lead_h strictly increasing, and the series read at the valid time within 0.05 m/s of wind_u_ms / wind_v_ms (both checked by validateScene).

precip_type.description: Optional precipitation type. Accepted and hashed; not rendered in v0 (TODO(M2) pass 7).

rh_pct.description: Optional near-surface relative humidity (%). Accepted and hashed; not rendered in v0 (TODO(M2) pass 6).

pbl_height_m_agl.description: Optional boundary-layer height above ground (m; HRRR HPBL is above the surface). Accepted and hashed; not rendered in v0 (TODO(M2): haze layer depth).

beta_per_km.description: Clear-air extinction, fitted per viewpoint on clear dev frames (PRD 9.3). v0: uniform below 2 km above the ground.

plate.description: The plate set the scene was issued for. The file hashes put the plate in scene_hash (PRD 10.3 paint gating, cache keys) and are checked against the files when rendering.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the plate file's bytes.

has_sky_mask.description: A sky mask image is supplied (R channel, 255 = sky). Without one, every pixel is terrain.

sky_mask_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sky-mask file; present exactly when has_sky_mask is true.

has_depth.description: A depth image is supplied: RGB24 metres along the view ray = R*65536 + G*256 + B; 0 = unknown, 16777215 = sky.

depth_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the depth file; present exactly when has_depth is true.

nominal_depth_m.description: Optional distance assumed for terrain pixels when has_depth is false (default 15000 m).

meta.description: Optional free-form provenance. Included in the scene hash; never read by the renderer.
